Hi Sam — great to hear the team is ready. Proposed plan + asks below.

Quick asks from our side before we finalize time:
- Final attendee list (names + roles) so we can lock calendar invites and prework owners.
- Any compliance or network pre-read we should review ahead of the kickoff (Ben's note).
- Success criteria top 3 items you want validated in week 1.

Availability (Pacific time) — pick two preferred slots and we'll turn one into a confirmed invite:
- Tue May 25, 09:00–10:30 PT (90m)
- Wed May 26, 13:00–14:30 PT (90m)
- Thu May 27, 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)

Proposed agenda (90m):
1) Intros & success criteria (15m)
2) High-level product demo (30m)
3) SE ops & infra review (20m)
4) Procurement & contract timing (10m)
5) Next steps, owners, milestone dates (15m)

I've attached a one-page draft of POC success criteria for your review (POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf) and a tentative calendar file (proposed-kickoff-calendar.ics) that we can adjust once you confirm attendees.

If procurement thinks they need the extra week, we can shift the kickoff to Jun 2–4; wanted to surface that tradeoff now so engineering and SE have visibility.

Thanks — I'll hold the slots until EOD PT.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0199

That would let us keep the technical kickoff on Wed May 26 while not delaying procurement decisions. If legal signals they need more time, we may ask to move the formal POC start by one week.
